overall: The AG found no violation for discussing an unposted topic, since the chair could not reasonably anticipate it, but found a violation for omitting the discussion from the minutes. Because the Board had already corrected the minutes, no additional relief was ordered.

allegations.summary: Board discussed legal-counsel expenditure requests at its January 23, 2012 meeting without listing them in the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: In exercising this discretion, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by permitting this discussion to occur during its meeting.

allegations.summary: Minutes of the January 23, 2012 meeting omitted any reference to the legal-counsel discussion, which the complainant said violated the law.
allegations.key_passage: The Board did violate the Open Meeting Law, however, by failing to include in the meeting minutes any reference to this same discussion.
